item.dc:creator: editorial@africanews.com (michael oduor)

item.title: McBurnie stoppage-time double earns Hull win over 10-man Brighton
item.description: Oli McBurnie's stoppage-time double earns victory for Hull City against second-placed Brighton in the Premier League. Fuente: BBC Sport.

item.title: Ngumoha stars as Liverpool thrash 10-man Man Utd
item.description: Mauricio Pochettino's reign as Manchester United head coach begins in desperate fashion as his team are thrashed by rivals Liverpool to remain in the Premier League relegation zone. Fuente: BBC Sport.

item.title: Camara to continue with Haas for final two races
item.description: Brazilian Rafael Camara will continue to race for the Haas team for the final two grands prix of the Formula 1 season. Fuente: BBC Sport.

item.title: Iraola 'enjoyed' big win over Man Utd
item.description: Liverpool head coach Andoni Iraola is pleased with his side's performance in their dominant win over Manchester United although he says that his side can still play better. Fuente: BBC Sport.

item.title: Mansion Relisted At $38.495 Million: Jenner relists estate; nearly $10 million below original price
item.description: Kylie Jenner's Holmby Hills mansion has returned to the market at a new asking price of $38.495 million, down from its previous listing of $48 million over a year ago. After purchasing the estate for $36.5 million in 2020, this marks her third attempt to find a buyer. The luxurious property boasts numerous amenities, including a basketball court and a home theatre, showcasing a blend of elegance and entertainment. Fuente: The Times of India - World.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: El Manchester United se hunde ante Liverpool en el debut de Pochettino
item.description: Los Diablos Rojos cayeron al penúltimo lugar de la liga inglesa después de una contundente goleada 4-0 en contra en Anfield. La expulsión del francés Leny Yoro marcó el estreno del técnico argentino. Una victoria en 11 partidos suma el United en la competición. Fuente: France 24 - Español.
item.dc:creator: AFP

item.title: From conceding seven to Hull heroics - how Tzolakis recovered to defy Brighton
item.description: Nine days after playing for Greece in a nightmare 7-0 loss, keeper Konstantinos Tzolakis plays a pivotal role in Hull's Premier League win against Brighton. Fuente: BBC Sport.

item.title: Pochettino on 'painful' defeat in first game as Man Utd boss
item.description: Manchester United's new head coach Mauricio Pochettino says his side must transform "anger" from their thumping at the hands of Liverpool into "energy" to improve under his reign. Fuente: BBC Sport.

item.title: Yoro sees red as Ngumoha shines - Liverpool v Man Utd player ratings
item.description: How Liverpool and Manchester United's players rated following their Premier League match. Fuente: BBC Sport.
